# DNS Kerberos Coercion

**Type:** TTP

**Author:** Raven Tait, Splunk

**Upstream version:** 1

## Description

Detects DNS-based Kerberos coercion attacks where adversaries inject marshaled credential structures into DNS records to spoof SPNs and redirect authentication such as in CVE-2025-33073. This detection leverages suricata looking for specific CREDENTIAL_TARGET_INFORMATION structures in DNS queries.

## MITRE ATT&CK

| ID | Technique | Tactics |
|---|---|---|
| [T1557.001](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1557/001/) | LLMNR/NBT-NS Poisoning and SMB Relay | credential-access, collection |
| [T1187](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1187/) | Forced Authentication | credential-access |
| [T1071.004](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1071/004/) | DNS | command-and-control |

## Analytic Stories

- Compromised Windows Host
- Suspicious DNS Traffic
- Local Privilege Escalation With KrbRelayUp
- Kerberos Coercion with DNS
